changeSet.author: Osmany Montero
changeSet.comment: Remap stored dashboard/visualization/menu field paths after the log->event OpenSearch bag rename (v11.3.0). Promoted fields map to their canonical protobuf slot (action, origin.*, target.*, deviceTime, severity, tenantId) so charts can aggregate; the rest map to event.* (flat_object, filter-only). REPLACE is idempotent: already-migrated or already-correct rows match nothing.
